notes.title: Small Changes and Fixes
notes.content:
+ Added an aiming line that shows when aim is blocked (Can be disabled)
* Prevent firing when turret is not aligned with crosshair (Can be disabled)
* Fix various gamemode issues when players fall into a pit

notes.title: Map Voting and Community Maps
notes.content:
+ Added map voting at game end
+ Added voting for approved community maps
* Walls now despawn after 3 minutes
* Decreased AFK timer to 1 minute

notes.title: Squad System and Matchmaking Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42794762/9403bbf267252de92cc19faa9f54836e9e2525b5.png[/img]

+ Squad System: Allows 4 players to enter matchmaking and play together on the same team
+ Added Team and Squad chat in game
+ Added send message button to in game player menu
* Team balancing now primarily uses gamemode specific Win/Loss instead of Kills/Deaths
* Change matchmaking to prioritize games that are not playing yet
* Increase lobby wait time if player count is less than half
* Improved matchmaking and server scalability

notes.title: New Gamemode: Hunted, Custom Games, Custom Maps, Map Editor Improvements
notes.content:
+ Custom public/private games with map selection (They do not earn XP)
+ User generated maps can now be uploaded and played in custom games
+ New Gamemode: Hunted
* Various map editor changes and improvements
* Game list now shows current map name
* Fixed local replays sometimes not saving (again) and increased limit to 25
* Improved low quality performance in Battle when round end ring is visible
* Fixed Battle ring killing players after round end

notes.title: Conquest Nukes and Battle Changes
notes.content:
+ Conquest: Matches now end with a nuclear bomb after a team holds all points for 35 seconds
+ Battle: After 2 minutes a shrinking ring will activate that kills players outside of it
+ Boosts can now be activated while playing a game
* Changed how often Conquest scores tick up
* Fixed local replays not always saving
* Improved performance a bit

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.content:
+ Conquest maps are now in rotation for Battle
* Wins/Losses/Draws now only get recorded if you have played for at least half of the match
* Win XP is now based on how long you were in the match
* Reduced lobby wait time to 15 seconds
* Game list page is now limited to current selected region
* Improved lag compensation
* Fixed smaller screens having farther vision in some cases
* Fixed Icebreaker replays not loading properly
* Removed rear shots in Battle from daily challenges
* Improved map loading to hopefully fix visual "grey box" glitches
* Bans/mutes can now have expiration times

notes.title: New Map, Holiday Bundle, and Balance Changes
notes.content:
+ New Map: Icebreaker (Conquest)
+ New Bundle: Holiday Bundle
* P-70 Serf: Updated side armor
* CY-76 Longbow: Updated side armor
* M4 Jumbo: Turn Force 62N⋅m -> 56N⋅m, Turret Speed 37°/s -> 26°/s
* SI-2 Tsar: Turn Force 68N⋅m -> 59N⋅m, Turret Speed 34°/s -> 24°/s
* Panthera: Turn Force 68N⋅m -> 60N⋅m, Turret Speed 47°/s -> 41°/s
* Tigress I: Turn Force 56N⋅m -> 51N⋅m, Turret Speed 34°/s -> 32°/s
* Queen Tigress: Turn Force 62N⋅m -> 53N⋅m
* Hefty Mk. 1: Turn Force 74N⋅m -> 68N⋅m, Turret Speed 36°/s -> 34°/s
* C3 Half-Track: Reload 3.5s -> 3.9s, Engine Reverse 120hp -> 108hp
* Increased XP for winning a game to 2500
* Increased XP for a point being captured to 400
* Landmines now despawn after 2 minutes
* Increased bot amount in Conquest
* Changed bot behavior in Conquest
* Increased guest game XP cutoff to rank 25

notes.title: Balance update
notes.content:
+ Added progress indicator for when you are repairing
+ Added game merging on round end if player count is low
* Repair time is now based on armor thickness (Min 8 sec, Max 12 sec)
* Lower caliber shells now have more penetration
* Higher caliber shells now have less penetration
* Penetration now decreases with shell travel distance
* Wall ricochet angle now increases with each ricochet
* Capture the Flag: Flags are now captured by taking them into a friendly capture zone
* Hamonag AT: Updated front armor hitbox
* Cheetah: Updated front armor hitbox
* Pummeler II: Updated front armor hitbox
* LT Mk. VI: Armament 53mm -> 47mm
* E1 Starhund: Decreased armor hardness, decreased shell penetration power
* Fixed map editor not starting play without a map name
* Fixed players sometimes appearing under objects on round end
* Fixed round end rank percentage rounding error

notes.title: Bug fixes and improvements
notes.content:
+ Added lag compensation setting
* Improved map loading on slower connections
* Changed Free for All XP rate to 0.85
* Fixed Tiger Hunt capture ring sometimes not working properly
* Fixed gold claim issue
* Fixed daily rewards issue
* Fixed players sometimes being able to glitch out of the map on Jungle map
* Server optimizations

notes.title: Map Editor and Gamemode Rotation
notes.content:
+ New map editor (No way to host matches with custom maps yet)
+ Gamemodes now automatically rotate every 7 days
+ Player cards now show on round end
+ New Gamemode: Team Deathmatch
* Tiger Hunt: Can now win by killing queen or by capturing circle in the center
* Players below rank 25 are now weighted lower for matchmaking
* Optimized map loading
* Fixed login not always working in Firefox
* Fixed win/draw issue with free for all gamemodes
* Fixed players sometimes spawning at map center in free for all gamemodes
* Fixed killfeed in Tank Game
* Weighted XP more for picking best replay at end of match
* Improved shell rendering with low FPS
* Increased Tigress, Panthera, and ANT-57 barrel length

This updates biggest feature is the map editor (Editor button is on the Battle screen at the bottom center). Anyone can create a map and test it right in game. There is no way to host the maps yet but eventually I want to add a way to host custom games along with player made maps. You can get help with map making on our Discord!

notes.title: New Gamemode: TANKBALL!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=FI3RoNDEPbE;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gKvmvQd.png[/img]

[h1]Tankball is here! [/h1]

This highly anticipated new gamemode adds a ball and a goal for each team. Use teamwork to outmaneuver your opponents, pass, shoot, and score! Compete in 4v4 matches on beautiful new maps in a whole new way to play STUG!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
+ New Gamemode: Tank Ball

+ New Bundle: Scorched Earth Bundle

+ New Camos: Cubist, Flaming, Ocean, Retro

+ New Decal Bundles: Fungus, Streets, Jersey, Scars

+ New Emotes: Salty, Tabby

+ Added versus indicator to Battle

+ Added setting to disable screen shake

* Ram damage is now based on tank type and weight

* E1 Starhund: Reload 1.5s -> 2.1s, Armament 26mm -> 30mm

* Haus: Engine Boost 650 hp -> 900 hp

* Jagdsherwin: Updated front armor hitbox

* Fixed vehicles being able to fire through walls

* Fixed multiple rams sometimes happening

* Fixed chat not closing when escape is pressed

* Fixed scoreboard not working during replays
[/list]
